acceptance.given: Disposable packages declare database-write capabilities. Independently authored variants supply both prerequisite declarations, omit backup prerequisites, omit recovery prerequisites, or omit prerequisites on a second database-write capability while retaining them on the first.

oracle.expected: Every database-write capability explicitly declares both backup and recovery prerequisites. The complete variant passes this prerequisite check; each omission variant returns fail with the applicable rule ID, capability-relative diagnostic path and code identifying the missing prerequisite. Derived results retain authorizes=[].
forbidden: A database-write capability passes with either prerequisite declaration missing.
Prerequisites declared for one capability satisfy another capability's missing declaration.
Static prerequisite validation is represented as a completed backup, restore drill or execution authorization.
An unconditional-pass validator satisfies the assertions.
oracle.observable: During independently assertion-bound parameter cases in scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_capabilities.py::test_a17, inspect each capability's explicit prerequisite declarations and compare structured results from direct calls to scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package against frozen expectations independent of candidate policy.

acceptance.then: Require explicit backup and recovery prerequisite declarations for every database-write capability and reject each independently missing declaration.
acceptance.when: The real validator statically inspects each disposable package under an explicitly supplied repository inspection root.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_capabilities.py::test_a17 with independently marked omission parameters and direct validate_package calls. Expect an observable AssertionError when a database-write declaration missing backup or recovery prerequisites is accepted, or when another capability's declaration masks that omission. Use the targeted argv command with a 300-second caller timeout. Missing production imports, absent tests, invocation errors and timeouts are blockers or harness failures, never causal RED.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Within the cohesive A3 capability-check context, validate explicit backup and recovery prerequisites separately for every database-write capability. Reuse A1/A2 foundation deliverables; do not implement database infrastructure, execute recovery operations or grant authority.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only this bounded prerequisite-check change through the owning workflow. Preserve existing quality and owner-specific protocols, database state, historical evidence and capability authority. Shared validator/policy/schema changes invalidate affected proofs.

slice_hint.state_transition: A database-write capability with incomplete prerequisite declarations becomes either explicitly complete or deterministically rejected for each missing prerequisite.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Each prerequisite parameter executes through the real callable with its own assertion bindings; complete declarations pass and independent omissions fail. Freeze tests/helpers and independent expectations before formal RED; production owners remain outside immutable snapshots, and Green/refactor cannot edit frozen tests. Q2 authors only the declared test/helper paths and disposable fixture variants. The currently absent callable must become executable under the existing owning protocol before controlled RED; report first-use blocking rather than seed production, fake an import or fabricate RED. Enforce the production write allowlist and NFR exclusions without new controllers, runtime infrastructure, knowledge publication or historical-evidence rewrites. Retain nonempty applicable regression coverage, invalidate affected shared proofs after production changes, and perform one current whole-plan terminal validation after all four modules and behaviors are available. Targeted commands have a 300-second caller timeout; terminal validation has 600 seconds. Timeouts never establish RED. Static results retain authorizes=[] and establish no restore-drill result. ADR-0041/0058 execution boundaries and ADR-0061 isolation remain intact; normal maintainer acceptance of ADR-0062 precedes Package A final acceptance or Package B consumption.
